prompt: Write a React TypeScript component `Tooltip` that wraps its children and shows a `content: string` on hover after a configurable `delayMs` (default 300), supports `placement: 'top'|'bottom'|'left'|'right'`, and dismisses on Escape. The tooltip content must render with `role="tooltip"`. Style with a CSS module.

Write a React TypeScript `Modal` component with `isOpen`, `onClose`, that traps focus while open, closes on Escape and on backdrop click, and renders via `createPortal` into `document.body`. The backdrop element must have `data-testid="modal-backdrop"`.

Build a compound `Tabs` component (`Tabs`, `Tabs.List`, `Tabs.Tab`, `Tabs.Panel`) using React Context, supporting both controlled (`activeKey`/`onChange`) and uncontrolled (`defaultActiveKey`) usage. Render each `Tabs.Tab` with `role="tab"` and each `Tabs.Panel` with `role="tabpanel"`.
Write a React TypeScript `Accordion` component that takes `items: {title: string, content: string}[]` and an `allowMultiple: boolean` prop controlling whether more than one panel can be open at once.

Build a `Pagination` component taking `totalItems`, `pageSize`, `currentPage`, `onPageChange`, rendering numbered page buttons (accessible via `role="button"` with their page number as name) with `...` ellipsis for large ranges.

Write an `Avatar` component with `src?: string`, `name: string`, `size: 'sm'|'md'|'lg'` that falls back to rendering initials from `name` when `src` fails to load. Style with a CSS module. Set the rendered ``'s `alt` attribute to `name`.
Build an `AvatarGroup` component that stacks up to a `max` number of `Avatar` children and shows a `+N` overflow badge for the rest.
Write a `ProgressBar` component with `value`, `max`, that renders an animated fill and sets `aria-valuenow`/`aria-valuemin`/`aria-valuemax` correctly, exposed with `role="progressbar"`.

Build a `Spinner` loading indicator component with `size: number` and `color: string` props, animated via a CSS `@keyframes` rotation. Give the root element `role="status"` and an accessible name of "Loading".
Build a `ToastProvider` + `useToast()` hook that lets any descendant call `toast.success('msg')` / `toast.error('msg')`, queues multiple toasts, and auto-dismisses each after a configurable timeout.

Write an `AlertBanner` component with `severity: 'info'|'warning'|'error'|'success'`, an icon per severity, and a dismiss button (accessible name containing 'dismiss' or 'close') that removes the banner from the DOM.

Build a `Breadcrumbs` component taking `items: {label: string, href?: string}[]`, rendering the last item as non-clickable current page with `aria-current="page"`, and earlier items as `<a>` elements with their `href`.
Write a `Chip` component with `label: string` and an optional `onRemove` handler that renders a small remove button (accessible name containing 'remove' or 'x') calling it.

Build a `Skeleton` loader component with `variant: 'text'|'circle'|'rect'` and a shimmering CSS gradient animation. Give the root element `role="status"` and a `data-variant` attribute matching the `variant` prop.

Write a `Stepper` component showing numbered steps from a `steps: string[]` array with `currentStep: number`, styling completed/active/upcoming steps differently. Mark the step matching `currentStep` with `aria-current="step"`.

Build a `RatingStars` component with `value`, `onChange`, that previews the rating on hover and supports left/right arrow key navigation. Implement each star as a `role="radio"` element within an implicit group.
Write a `Switch` toggle component with controlled `checked`/`onChange` and a `disabled` prop, styled as a sliding pill switch in plain CSS. Expose it with `role="switch"`.

Build a `CheckboxGroup` component taking `options: {label: string, value: string}[]`, `selected: string[]`, and `onChange(selected: string[])`. Each checkbox must be associated with its label via `htmlFor`/`id`.
Write a generic `RadioGroup<T extends string>` component that is keyboard-navigable with arrow keys per the WAI-ARIA `radiogroup` pattern, exposing each option with `role="radio"`.

Build a `Slider` range input component with `min`, `max`, `step`, `value`, `onChange`, and a draggable thumb, implemented without any external library. Expose the thumb as `role="slider"` with `aria-valuenow` reflecting `value`, and support Left/Right arrow keys to change it by `step`.

Write a `SearchInput` component that debounces `onSearch(query: string)` by 300ms, shows a loading spinner while an `isLoading` prop is true, and has a clear ('x') button. The text field must have `role="textbox"`.

Build an `Autocomplete` combobox component that filters an `options: string[]` array as the user types, and supports Up/Down/Enter keyboard navigation. Expose the input with `role="combobox"` and call `onSelect(option)`.

Write a generic `DataTable<T>` component taking `columns: {key: keyof T, header: string}[]` and `rows: T[]`, with clickable column headers that toggle ascending/descending sort. Render rows/cells with `role="row"`/`role="cell"`.
Build a recursive `TreeView` component rendering nested nodes of shape `{label: string, children?: Node[]}`, with expand/collapse toggles per node triggered by clicking the node's label.

Write a collapsible `Sidebar` nav component with an `isCollapsed` boolean state that animates its width via a CSS transition. Set `aria-expanded` on the root element (with `data-testid="sidebar"`) to the inverse of `isCollapsed`.

Build a responsive `Navbar` component that collapses into a hamburger menu below a 768px breakpoint using CSS media queries. Label the hamburger toggle button with an accessible name containing "menu".
Write a `Carousel` component that auto-advances through `slides: React.ReactNode[]` every `intervalMs`, pauses on hover, and has manual next/prev buttons labelled 'Next slide' / 'Previous slide'.
Build a `Lightbox` component that opens a fullscreen overlay for a clicked thumbnail image and closes on Escape key or clicking outside the image. Render the open overlay image with `role="dialog"`.

Write a `FileDropzone` component supporting drag-and-drop and click-to-browse file selection, calling `onFilesAdded(files: File[])`, and highlighting the drop area while dragging over it. Give the drop area `role="button"` with an accessible name containing "upload" or "drop".

Build a `SortableList` component that lets users reorder a list of `{id: string, label: string}[]` items via pointer-event drag handles (no external DnD library). Give each item's drag handle `data-testid="drag-handle-{id}"` and call `onReorder(newOrder: string[])` with the reordered array of ids after a drag completes.

Write a generic `InfiniteScrollList<T>` component that calls `onLoadMore()` when a sentinel `<div>` at the bottom becomes visible, using `IntersectionObserver`. Render the sentinel element with `data-testid="scroll-sentinel"`.

Build a `VirtualizedList` component that renders only the currently visible rows of a large array based on scroll offset and a fixed row height. Give the scroll container `data-testid="virtualized-list"` and each rendered row `role="listitem"`.

Write a `MultiStepForm` wizard component that manages the current step index and renders only that step's `children`, exposing `onNext`/`onBack`. Accept a `steps: React.ReactNode[]` prop and render a 'Next' button.

Build a `LoginForm` component with `email`/`password` fields (labelled 'Email' and 'Password'), client-side validation, an `onSubmit(values)` callback, and a submit button ('Log in') disabled until the form is valid.
Write a `PasswordStrengthMeter` component that scores a `password: string` on length and character-class variety, rendering a colored bar and a text label ('Weak'/'Medium'/'Strong').

Build an `OtpInput` component that renders `length` single-digit boxes (each `role="textbox"`), auto-advances focus as digits are typed, supports backspace-to-previous, and handles pasting a full code.

Write a `ColorPicker` component showing a grid of preset swatches plus a custom hex text input, calling `onChange(hex: string)` on selection. Label the custom hex input with an accessible name of "Hex color".

Build a `TagInput` component letting users add free-text tags by pressing Enter and remove the last tag with Backspace when the input is empty. Accept controlled `tags: string[]` and `onChange(tags: string[])`.

Build a `CommandPalette` component (Cmd+K style) that filters a list of `{label: string, action: () => void}` commands as the user types and runs the selected one on Enter. Render the filter field as `role="textbox"` and each matching command as plain visible text.

Build a `ContextMenu` component that appears at the cursor position on right-click with a list of clickable actions and closes on outside click. Render the menu with `role="menu"` and each action as `role="menuitem"`.

Write a `Popover` component anchored to a trigger element that closes when the user clicks outside of it. Accept a `trigger: React.ReactNode` prop and render popover content with `data-testid="popover-content"` while open.

Build a `Drawer` component that slides in from `side: 'left'|'right'`, has a backdrop that closes it on click, and animates with a CSS transform transition. The backdrop element must have `data-testid="drawer-backdrop"`.

Write a `SplitPane` component with two resizable panels separated by a draggable divider, persisting the split ratio in component state. Give the draggable divider `role="separator"`, `aria-valuenow` reflecting the split ratio, and `data-testid="split-divider"`.

Build a simple `KanbanBoard` component with columns of draggable cards, moving a card between columns using native HTML5 drag-and-drop events. Give each card `draggable` with `data-testid="card-{id}"`, each column `data-testid="column-{columnId}"`, and call `onCardMove(cardId, targetColumnId)` on drop.
Write an `EventCalendar` month-view component that highlights days present in an `events: {date: string}[]` array. Mark days that have an event with `data-has-event="true"` (and `"false"` otherwise).
Build a `Timeline` component rendering a vertical list of `{date: string, title: string, description: string}` entries with a connecting line drawn in CSS.

Write a `NotificationCenter` dropdown showing an unread-count badge and a list of notifications, marking each as read when clicked. Show the unread count in a badge with `data-testid="unread-badge"`, and mark clicked notifications as read.

Build a `ChatMessageList` component that auto-scrolls to the bottom when a new message is appended, styling sent vs. received messages differently. Render sent messages with `data-sender="me"` and received messages with `data-sender="them"`.
Write a recursive `CommentThread` component rendering nested replies with CSS indentation proportional to depth.

Build a `CodeBlock` component that renders `code: string` in a `<pre>` with a 'Copy' button using the Clipboard API and shows 'Copied!' feedback for 2 seconds. The copy button's accessible name must contain 'Copy', and the feedback text must contain 'Copied'.
Write an `EmptyState` component with an icon, `title`, `description`, and an optional call-to-action passed as `children`.

Build a class-based `ErrorBoundary` component that catches render errors from its children and shows a fallback UI with a 'Retry' button that resets the error state. Render fallback text containing "Something went wrong".

Write a `LazyImage` component that only sets its `src` once the element scrolls into view (via `IntersectionObserver`), showing a placeholder before that. Give the placeholder element `data-testid="lazy-placeholder"`.
Build a `ThemeToggle` button that switches between light/dark by toggling a `data-theme` attribute on `document.documentElement` and persists the choice to `localStorage`.
Write a `CookieConsentBanner` component shown until the user clicks 'Accept', persisting dismissal to `localStorage` so it doesn't reappear.

Build a `StatCard` component showing a metric `label`, `value`, and a small trend indicator (arrow + percentage) colored green for positive and red for negative. Show the signed trend value as visible text (e.g. '+12%' or '-4%') and set `data-trend="up"`/`"down"` on that element.
Write a `QuantityStepper` numeric input with +/- buttons (accessible names '+' and '-') that clamps the value to `min`/`max` and disables the relevant button at each bound.
Build a `PromoCodeInput` field with an 'Apply' button that calls an async `validateCode(code: string): Promise<boolean>` prop and shows an inline success or error message.
Write a `useConfirm()` hook plus a reusable `ConfirmDialog` component so any code can call `await confirm('Are you sure?')` and get a boolean result. Render 'OK' and 'Cancel' buttons in the dialog.

Build a `SegmentedControl` component (tab-styled radio group) with `options`, `value`, `onChange`, highlighting the selected pill. Implement each option as a `role="radio"` element inside a `role="radiogroup"` container.

Write a `Rating` summary component showing an average score out of 5 as filled/half/empty stars plus a `(count)` label, given `average: number` and `count: number`. Render the count as visible text formatted like `(128)`, and mark each filled star with `data-testid="star-filled"`.
Build a `WishlistButton` heart-icon toggle component with a controlled `isSaved` boolean and a brief CSS scale/pulse animation on click.
Write a `ShareButtonGroup` component rendering share links for a given `url` and `title` (copy-link, and two placeholder social buttons), with copy-link showing a 'Copied' tooltip.
Write a custom hook `useThrottledCallback<Args extends unknown[]>(fn: (...args: Args) => void, limitMs: number)` that returns a throttled version of `fn`.
Write a custom hook `useLocalStorage<T>(key: string, initialValue: T): [T, (value: T) => void]` synced to `localStorage`, handling JSON parse errors gracefully by falling back to `initialValue`.
Write a custom hook `useSessionStorage<T>(key: string, initialValue: T)` analogous to `useLocalStorage` but backed by `sessionStorage`.
Write a custom hook `usePrevious<T>(value: T): T | undefined` that returns the value from the previous render.
Write a custom hook `useToggle(initial?: boolean): [boolean, () => void]` for toggling a boolean flag.
Write a custom hook `useCounter(initial?: number, options?: {min?: number, max?: number, step?: number})` returning `{count, increment, decrement, reset}`.
Write a custom hook `useWindowSize(): {width: number, height: number}` that updates on window resize via a debounced listener.
Write a custom hook `useMediaQuery(query: string): boolean` wrapping `window.matchMedia` and updating on change events.
Write a custom hook `useOnClickOutside<T extends HTMLElement>(ref: RefObject<T>, handler: () => void)` that attaches and cleans up a document click listener.
Write a custom hook `useHover<T extends HTMLElement>(): [RefObject<T>, boolean]` tracking whether the ref'd element is currently hovered.
Write a custom hook `useKeyPress(targetKey: string): boolean` that returns whether the given key is currently held down.
Write a custom hook `useCopyToClipboard(): [copiedText: string | null, copy: (text: string) => Promise<boolean>]`.
Write a generic custom hook `useAsync<T>(asyncFn: () => Promise<T>, deps: unknown[]): {data: T | null, error: Error | null, loading: boolean}` that re-runs when `deps` change.
Write a generic custom hook `useFetch<T>(url: string): {data: T | null, error: Error | null, loading: boolean}` using `fetch` with `AbortController` cleanup on unmount or url change.
Write a custom hook `useInterval(callback: () => void, delayMs: number | null)` where passing `null` pauses the interval, cleaning it up on unmount.
Write a custom hook `useIsMounted(): () => boolean` returning a stable function for checking whether the component is still mounted before calling `setState`.
Write a generic custom hook `useEventListener<K extends keyof WindowEventMap>(eventName: K, handler: (e: WindowEventMap[K]) => void)` attached to `window`.
Write a custom hook `useIntersectionObserver(ref: RefObject<Element>, options?: IntersectionObserverInit): boolean` returning whether the element is currently in view.
Write a custom hook `useScrollPosition(): {x: number, y: number}` tracking `window.scrollX`/`scrollY` with a passive scroll listener.
Write a custom hook `useOnlineStatus(): boolean` tracking `navigator.onLine` with `online`/`offline` window event listeners.
Write a custom hook `useGeolocation(): {coords: GeolocationCoordinates | null, error: string | null, loading: boolean}` wrapping `navigator.geolocation.watchPosition`.
Write a custom hook `useDarkMode(): [boolean, (value: boolean) => void]` that defaults to `prefers-color-scheme` and persists any manual override to `localStorage`.
Write a generic custom hook `usePagination<T>(items: T[], pageSize: number)` returning `{currentPageItems, page, totalPages, nextPage, prevPage, goToPage}`.

Write a generic custom hook `useForm<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(initialValues: T)` returning `{values, errors, handleChange, handleSubmit, reset}` with a pluggable `validate` function. Accept the `validate` function as `useForm(initialValues, validate)`.
Write a generic custom hook `useUndo<T>(initialPresent: T)` returning `{state, set, undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo}`.
Write a generic custom hook `useQueryParams<T extends Record<string, string>>(): [T, (params: Partial<T>) => void]` reading and writing `URLSearchParams` and syncing to browser history.
Write a custom hook `useAbortableFetch<T>(url: string)` that cancels the previous in-flight request whenever `url` changes before the prior one resolves.
Write a custom hook `useIdleTimer(timeoutMs: number, onIdle: () => void)` that resets a timer on mouse/keyboard activity and calls `onIdle` after `timeoutMs` of inactivity.
Write a custom hook `useLongPress(callback: () => void, ms?: number)` returning event handlers `{onMouseDown, onMouseUp, onMouseLeave, onTouchStart, onTouchEnd}` to spread onto an element.
Write a generic custom hook `useResizeObserver<T extends HTMLElement>(): [RefObject<T>, DOMRectReadOnly | null]` tracking an element's size changes.
Write a custom hook `usePortal(id: string): HTMLElement` that creates (or reuses) a DOM node appended to `document.body`, cleaning it up on unmount if it created it.
Write a custom hook `useLockBodyScroll(locked: boolean)` that sets `document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'` while `locked` is true, restoring the previous value on cleanup.
Write a custom hook `useCountdown(targetTimestamp: number): {days: number, hours: number, minutes: number, seconds: number, isExpired: boolean}` that recalculates every second.
Write a custom hook `useStopwatch(): {elapsedMs: number, isRunning: boolean, start: () => void, pause: () => void, reset: () => void}`.
Write a custom hook `useStep(totalSteps: number)` returning `{currentStep, next, back, goTo, isFirst, isLast}`, clamped to the valid `[0, totalSteps - 1]` range.
Write a polymorphic `Box<C extends React.ElementType = 'div'>` component that supports an `as` prop to render as any HTML tag while preserving correct prop typing for that tag.
Write a `Button` component using `React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>` so consumers can attach a ref to the underlying `<button>` DOM node.

Define a discriminated union `type AsyncState<T> = {status: 'idle'} | {status: 'loading'} | {status: 'success', data: T} | {status: 'error', error: string}` and write a component that renders each case exhaustively, using a `never` check to catch missing cases at compile time. Name the rendering component `AsyncStateView` with a `state: AsyncState<string>` prop; show 'Loading...' for the loading case.

Write a type guard `function isString(value: unknown): value is string` and use it inside a component to safely render a prop typed as `unknown`. Wrap it in a component `SafeText` that takes a `value: unknown` prop and renders it as text only when `isString(value)` is true.
Build a `FormContext`, `FormProvider`, and `useFormContext()` hook trio using React Context, throwing a runtime error if `useFormContext` is called outside of `FormProvider`.

Write a `cartReducer(state: CartState, action: CartAction)` reducer with a discriminated-union `CartAction` type (`'ADD_ITEM' | 'REMOVE_ITEM' | 'CLEAR'`), plus a `useReducer`-based `useCart()` hook wrapping it.

Build a compound `Select`/`Select.Option` component using `React.Children.map` and `cloneElement` to inject shared selection state into its `Select.Option` children only. Render `Select.Option` as `role="option"` and call `onChange(value)` when one is selected.

Write a higher-order component `withLoading

(Component: React.ComponentType

)` that injects an `isLoading` prop and renders a spinner in place of `Component` while true. The loading placeholder must have `role="status"`.
Implement a render-props component `<MousePosition>{(pos: {x: number, y: number}) => React.ReactNode}</MousePosition>` that tracks the mouse's current coordinates.
Write a generic `List<T>` component taking `items: T[]`, `renderItem: (item: T) => React.ReactNode`, and `keyExtractor: (item: T) => string`.

Define a utility type `DeepPartial<T>` and use it to type an optional `initialValues` prop on a `SettingsForm` component. The settings form must include an 'Email notifications' checkbox bound to `notifications.email`.

Write a generic `Field<TValues, TName extends keyof TValues>` component that binds to a specific key of a form values object with the correct value type inferred from `TValues[TName]`. Bind it to an `<input>` via `values`, `name`, and `onChange(name, value)` props.
Build an `ErrorBoundary` typed with `componentDidCatch` and a `fallback: React.ReactNode | ((error: Error) => React.ReactNode)` prop that supports both a static node and a render function.

Write a `useReducer`-based state machine hook `useTrafficLight()` with states `'red' | 'yellow' | 'green'` and a typed `transition()` function that only permits valid next states. Cycle red -> green -> yellow -> red; `transition(next)` takes the target state and is typed to only accept the valid next state.
Write a `Portal` component typed to accept `children: React.ReactNode` and an optional `containerId?: string`, rendering via `ReactDOM.createPortal`.
Implement a `React.memo`-wrapped `ExpensiveList<T>` component with a custom `areEqual` comparator correctly typed against its props.
Write a generic `useLocalReducer<S, A>(reducer: (state: S, action: A) => S, initialState: S)` wrapper hook that adds a `dispatchLogged` function logging every action before dispatching it.
Build a `Tooltip` component that clones its single child via `cloneElement` to attach `onMouseEnter`/`onMouseLeave` handlers, typed with `React.Children.only` to require exactly one child.
Write a generic `Table<T extends {id: string | number}>` component that infers each column's value type from a `columns: {key: keyof T, header: string}[]` array.

Define a branded type `type Email = string & {__brand: 'Email'}` with a `parseEmail(input: string): Email | null` validator, and an `EmailField` component that only accepts `Email`-typed values in its `onChange`.
Style a `Card` component with a CSS module using a responsive grid layout (`display: grid`) that collapses from 3 columns to 1 column below a 640px viewport width.
Add dark-mode theming to an existing `Button` component using CSS custom properties (`--btn-bg`, `--btn-fg`) that are overridden under a `[data-theme='dark']` attribute selector.
Write a `FadeIn` wrapper component that applies a `@keyframes fadeIn` CSS animation to its `children` when it mounts.
Style a `Card` component's hover state with a smooth `transform: translateY(-4px)` and `box-shadow` transition, using plain CSS with no libraries.
Build a responsive `Masonry` grid layout component using the CSS `columns` property, with no JavaScript-based layout calculation.
Style a sticky table header for a `DataTable` component using `position: sticky; top: 0` inside a scrollable container `<div>`.

Build a `TruncatedText` component that ellipsis-truncates overflowing text via `text-overflow: ellipsis`, supporting a `lines` prop for multi-line clamping via `-webkit-line-clamp`. Render the full `text` prop as the element's text content regardless of the `lines` clamp (clamping is purely visual, done in CSS).
Write custom scrollbar styles (`::-webkit-scrollbar`) in a `ScrollableList` component's CSS module, with a `scrollbar-width: thin` fallback for Firefox.
Add `:focus-visible` outline styles to a `Button` and `Input` component's CSS module for clear keyboard-only focus indication (no visible outline on mouse click, visible outline on Tab focus).
Build a `MediaFrame` layout component using CSS `aspect-ratio: 16 / 9` to keep an embedded video or image at a fixed ratio regardless of container width.
Add print-only styles (`@media print`) to an `Invoice` component that hide navigation/buttons and force black text on a white background.
Style an RTL-aware `Sidebar` component using CSS logical properties (`margin-inline-start`, `padding-inline-end`) instead of physical `left`/`right`.

Build a `ProgressRing` SVG component styled via CSS with a `stroke-dashoffset` transition animating to match a `progress: number` (0-100) prop. Expose the SVG's stroke element with `data-testid="progress-ring-fill"` and `aria-valuenow` equal to `progress`.

Build a `StickyHeader` component that shrinks its height and font size via CSS transition once the page scrolls past a threshold, tracked with a scroll event listener. Give the header `role="banner"` and a `data-shrunk` attribute reflecting whether the scroll threshold has been passed.
Style a `PricingTable` using CSS Grid, highlighting the 'recommended' plan's column with a different background and a 'Popular' ribbon rendered via `::before`.
Add container-query styles (`@container`) to a `ProductCard` component so its layout switches from vertical to horizontal once its containing element is wide enough.
Build a `SkeletonCard` component with a shimmering `background: linear-gradient` animation driven by `@keyframes` and animated `background-position`. Give the root element `role="status"`.

Style `Input` form components with distinct CSS classes for `:invalid`, `:focus`, and a `data-error='true'` attribute-driven error state. Set `data-error="true"`/`"false"` on the input based on whether the `error` prop is present.
Build a `ChipList` component that wraps chips into multiple rows using `flex-wrap: wrap` with a consistent gap via the CSS `gap` property.

Add a `BackToTopButton` that fades in via an opacity CSS transition once the user scrolls past 400px, and is `pointer-events: none` and invisible otherwise. Set `aria-hidden` on the button to reflect whether it is currently visible, with an accessible name containing 'back to top'.
Build a `SignupForm` with `name`, `email`, `password`, `confirmPassword` fields, validating matching passwords and email format on blur, with inline error messages per field.
Write a custom hook `useFieldValidation(value: string, rules: ValidationRule[])` returning `{isValid: boolean, errorMessage: string | null}`, composing rules like `required`, `minLength`, `pattern`.

Build an `AddressForm` component with a country-dependent field set (e.g. 'ZIP code' vs 'Postal code' label) driven by the selected `country` value. Default `country` to 'US' (label 'ZIP code'); selecting 'CA' switches the label to 'Postal code'.

Write a `CreditCardInput` component that formats digits into groups of 4 as the user types and validates the number via the Luhn algorithm on blur, showing an error message containing 'invalid card number' when it fails.
Build a generic `DynamicFieldArray<T>` component letting users add and remove repeated form rows (e.g. 'Add another phone number'), backed by a typed `T[]` values array.
Write a `FormWizard` component that validates each step's fields before enabling 'Next', keeping the button disabled until the current step is valid.

Build a `FileUploadField` form control that validates file type and max size client-side before calling `onChange`, showing the specific rejection reason if invalid. Label the file input with an accessible name containing 'upload'.

Write a custom hook `useAsyncValidation(value: string, validateFn: (v: string) => Promise<boolean>)` that debounces calls to an async validator (e.g. 'is this username taken?') and returns `{isValidating, isValid}`.

Build a `DatePicker` input component with `minDate`/`maxDate` constraints and a typed `onChange(date: Date | null)` callback, disabling out-of-range day buttons (each day rendered as a `role="button"` labelled with its day number).
Write a `PhoneNumberInput` component that formats input as `(XXX) XXX-XXXX` while the user types, while storing only the raw digits internally.

Build a `SettingsForm` component that only enables its 'Save' button once at least one field's value differs from its initial value (dirty-checking). Accept `initialValues: {displayName: string}` and label the field 'Display Name'.

Write a generic custom hook `useFormState<T>(initialValues: T, validate: (values: T) => Partial<Record<keyof T, string>>)` returning `{values, errors, isValid, handleChange, handleBlur, handleSubmit}`.
Build a `SearchFilters` panel with checkboxes, a price-range slider, and a 'Clear all' button that resets a typed filter-state object to its defaults.
Write a `TermsCheckbox` component pairing a checkbox with a label containing an inline link, required (via a callback prop) before a parent form's submit button becomes enabled.
Build a `QuizForm` component rendering multiple-choice questions from a typed `Question[]` array, tracking the user's selected answers, and computing a score when submitted.
